decisions.reason: Requiring templates to be delivered as full builds refines the separate template-specific Requirement; the broader rule that most companion resources are finished products remains valid unchanged.
The template delivery change does not alter the separate rule that videos are delivered as scripts and recorded by the editorial team.
The production standard for companion templates does not change the content or length policy of the first-time-leader questions chapter.
The template build standard does not change the mandatory or optional layers used in manuscript answers.
The companion-template delivery standard does not alter the AI chapter's required subject matter or length guidance.
Delivering companion templates as full builds does not affect the Google Doc manuscript-editing and question-removal workflow.
The template build standard does not change the candidate-questions chapter's subject or length guidance.
The companion-template delivery change does not alter review, removal, rationale, or streamlining rules for the existing question set.
The template production standard does not affect the manuscript's international-perspective markets or integration approach.
The template delivery change does not alter the pre-interview chapter's audience, content, international guidance, or length policy.
The companion-template build requirement does not change the remote and hybrid leadership chapter's subject or length guidance.
The production standard for separate companion templates does not change the 110,000-word ceiling for the complete manuscript.
